spec.context: RETAKE of the auth sheet after fixes. Screen: auth bottom sheet over the reports EmptyState. Contract NOW: grab handle (grey, visible), heading "Sign in", grey caption, mode toggle = TWO chips where the SELECTED one is SOFT TEAL (tealLiveSoft bg #CCFBF1 + tealLive text — reads as a state, NOT a primary), unselected chip quiet grey, email + password fields = white fill + 1px hairline border (the app-wide input grammar), ONE black "Sign in" pill submit (the only strong primary on the sheet), quiet footer disclosure. Judge: is there now exactly ONE strong primary, does the teal tab read clearly as selected-state, fields consistent, spacing rhythm, contrast.

measured_notes: Sheet: grab handle visible at top, grey, ~32x4px — contract met
One strong primary only: black 'Sign in' pill (~44-48px tall) at sheet bottom; the background 'Sign in' chip on the EmptyState is grey/quiet, not a competing strong primary
Selected chip 'Sign in' uses soft teal bg (~#CCFBF1) with teal text (~#0F766E est.) — estimated contrast ~4.6:1, reads as selected state, not primary
Unselected chip 'Create account' is quiet grey (~#F4F4F2 bg, ~#1A1A19 text) — clearly secondary to the teal tab
Email + password fields: white fill, 1px hairline grey border, consistent height (~52px), consistent radius — matches app input grammar
Field labels 'Email'/'Password' dark grey on white, estimated ≥7:1 — AA pass
Placeholder text (you@example.com / Your password) estimated ~#9CA3AF on white ≈ 2.8:1 — placeholders are exempt-ish but noted
Footer disclosure 'Sessions are 7-day and revocable…' grey small text, est ~#6B7280 ≈ 4.6:1 — AA pass
Gutters: sheet content edges ~16px; internal gaps ~12px between chips, label→field, field→field — rhythm consistent
Touch targets: chips ~44px tall, inputs ~52px, submit ~48px — all ≥44px
No truncation observed; captions wrap cleanly on two lines in EmptyState body
non_blocking_notes: Scrim over EmptyState is uniform grey — fine, but the EmptyState's own grey 'Sign in' chip duplicates the sheet heading text; consider differentiating copy
Caption 'Your bookings and tokens sync to your account.' could state what happens if the user has no account yet (never a dead end); minor copy polish
Placeholder grey on white is the lightest text on the sheet; consider one step darker for low-vision users
Radius of chips vs submit pill vs inputs is consistent enough; confirm the token in the system
verdict.one_line: Retake passes: exactly one strong primary, teal reads as selected-state, fields consistent, spacing and contrast on-contract.
